goal: Use existing customer, vendor and item/service read-first evidence to decide the next training, handbook and data-route gaps without opening Business Central or editing the book.
whyNow: Foundation setup routes are parked, but PWS-MD-001, PWS-MD-002 and PWS-MD-003 already contain real Universaarl UI observations that can be curated into training and handbook preparation.
businessPurpose: Turn observed Master Data UI into practical customer-training and implementation handoff value while setup and process writes remain blocked.
expectedOutput: A compact local result JSON that classifies customer, vendor and item/service evidence as training-ready, handbook-gap, data-route-gap or blocked.
A nextCase selection that either prepares one read-first dependency probe or one local route/data decision.
Explicit boundary that no book text, setup, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting change was made.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision would require opening Business Central or running Playwright live.
Stop if the output would create a final book claim or edit book text.
Stop if the output would claim setup, Master Data, O2C, P2P, Preview Posting or Posting readiness.
Stop if a required dependency cannot be classified from existing evidence.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if the local gap decision identifies a specific customer UI dependency that needs read-first evidence.
Use if the local gap decision shows the next useful step is deciding between UI, templates, configuration packages or Excel-assisted routes.
Use if customer/vendor/item training cannot progress because setup dependencies are too unclear.
